record.title: Add verified-email onboarding, immutable receipts, privacy operations, and authoritative account closure

endpoints.before: The portal had no self-service account closure or verified-email/terms onboarding. Cached key identity could be used without a fresh account-closure lookup, and active console sessions did not check onboarding.
endpoints.after: Initial publication gates dashboard and console access on verified email followed by explicit terms acceptance. Existing external API keys keep working even after an incomplete dashboard visit. Account closure deletes active credentials and rejects warm/delayed key caches through a primary lookup before quota/cache/upstream access (401 INVALID_API_KEY). Credential/account lookup failure returns uncacheable 503 ACCOUNT_STATUS_UNAVAILABLE with Retry-After: 30; HEAD has no body. Public and configured anonymous bypasses retain their prior behavior. Already-admitted requests may finish; acceptance does not restore revoked keys or reset quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: Existing API-key integrations need no onboarding change for this initial rollout. Dashboard/console users must verify a notification email and accept published terms; closure permanently ends their credentials. Retry ACCOUNT_STATUS_UNAVAILABLE after Retry-After; do not automatically retry agreement-related 403 responses.

record.title: Report email verification before terms acceptance in dashboard and console onboarding

endpoints.before: During an active rollout, signed-in dashboard console requests with unverified email and no terms acceptance returned 403 AGREEMENT_REQUIRED. Dashboard gates also advertised terms before verification.
endpoints.after: Dashboard console requests return 403 EMAIL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED until email is verified, then 403 AGREEMENT_REQUIRED until the current terms edition is accepted. Dashboard gates list required terms only after verification. Public API-key access, anonymous access, eligibility, quotas and successful responses are unchanged.
endpoints.clientAction: Console clients should handle EMAIL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED by verifying the notification email first, then handle AGREEMENT_REQUIRED by accepting the current terms. Existing application API-key integrations require no change.

record.title: Enforce shared 100,000 requests/month allowance across free account projects

endpoints.before: Free projects were governed only by the 120 requests/minute per-project quota and expensive v1 per-operation limits without a monthly account cap, and RateLimit-Policy headers assumed 60-second windows.
endpoints.after: Free accounts share an authoritative 100,000 requests/month allowance across all free projects, API keys, and console sessions across legacy and v1 gateways, resetting on the 1st of each calendar month at 00:00 UTC alongside existing per-project minute and expensive-operation limits. Paid projects (pro, enterprise) are exempt, while custom RPM overrides on free projects retain the monthly cap. Key rotation/deletion and project recreation never reset account usage. Monthly exhaustion returns 429 MONTHLY_QUOTA_EXCEEDED with Retry-After until reset and calendar-aware RateLimit headers; unavailable accounting returns 503 QUOTA_UNAVAILABLE.
endpoints.clientAction: Track free-account monthly usage in the developer portal or via RateLimit headers, respect Retry-After until 00:00 UTC on the 1st of next month on 429 MONTHLY_QUOTA_EXCEEDED, or request a Pro/Enterprise tier upgrade in Rate Limits.

record.title: Share gateway quotas across project keys and restrict project creation

endpoints.before: Authenticated legacy gateway requests used independent per-key, per-Cloudflare-location tier counters, separate from v1 and console quotas; approved custom RPM did not govern this limiter. Accounts could create up to ten projects with a non-atomic check.
endpoints.after: All API keys and console sessions in a project share one exact UTC-aligned 60-second global quota across authenticated legacy/v1 gateway traffic, using project tier/custom RPM. Expensive v1 caps are shared per project. Cache hits count; quota exhaustion returns 429 and unavailable admission returns retryable 503 QUOTA_UNAVAILABLE. Legacy responses expose project RateLimit headers. Accounts include one project unless an operator approves more; atomic creation enforces a 24-hour cooldown that survives deletion. Existing projects and keys remain usable.
endpoints.clientAction: Keep existing keys; coordinate request budgets across the project's keys, console and API versions. Respect Retry-After and request a project limit increase if necessary. Contact the egdata team for additional projects; creating or rotating keys no longer adds capacity. See docs/project-quota-rollout.md for migration and existing-grant review.

Expensive v1 caps are shared per project. Cache hits count; quota exhaustion returns 429 and unavailable admission returns retryable 503 QUOTA_UNAVAILABLE. Legacy responses expose project RateLimit headers. Accounts include one project unless an operator approves more; atomic creation enforces a 24-hour cooldown that survives deletion. Existing projects and keys remain usable.
endpoints.clientAction: Keep existing keys; coordinate request budgets across the project's keys, console and API versions. Respect Retry-After and request a project limit increase if necessary. Contact the egdata team for additional projects; creating or rotating keys no longer adds capacity. See docs/project-quota-rollout.md for migration and existing-grant review.

Expensive v1 caps are shared per project. Cache hits count; quota exhaustion returns 429 and unavailable admission returns retryable 503 QUOTA_UNAVAILABLE. Legacy responses expose project RateLimit headers. Accounts include one project unless an operator approves more; atomic creation enforces a 24-hour cooldown that survives deletion. Existing projects and keys remain usable.

record.title: Remove Aikido origin runtime blocking and telemetry

endpoints.before: Requests reaching the Node origin passed globally installed Aikido runtime instrumentation and middleware, which could send request/security telemetry and impose Aikido-specific blocking or rate-limit grouping before the route handler.
endpoints.after: The updated origin no longer loads the Aikido SDK, sends its runtime telemetry, creates its IP/UA-derived user identity, or applies its blocking/grouping. Existing authentication, origin access controls, gateway quotas, legacy rate limits and custom legacy anti-abuse remain. Gateway-local responses that never reach the origin retain their prior behavior. v1 remains outside custom legacy challenges. Historical provider data is not erased by this code change; origin deployment is required.
endpoints.clientAction: None. Continue honoring existing authentication, quotas and Retry-After responses. This record does not confirm production deployment.

record.title: Expose API gateway hostname and harden Worker edge caching

endpoints.before: The API gateway Worker was not bound to `api.egdata.app`; legacy responses forwarded through the Worker passed origin CORS and freshness headers through unchanged, and no Worker edge cache served these responses.
endpoints.after: The Worker is now bound to `api.egdata.app` for legacy gateway requests. Forwarded responses set caller-specific CORS headers and eligible GET/HEAD responses may be served from the post-authentication Worker edge cache with a route-specific public max-age instead of the origin CDN-Cache-Control header. Authentication, permissions, quota admission, response bodies, status codes, and error contracts are unchanged.

endpoints.clientAction: None

record.title: Add the versioned v1 API with explicit scopes and per-key quotas

endpoints.before: GET /v1/autocomplete was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Offer title autocomplete. Response media: application/json. Requires an API key with search:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: POST /v1/offers/exists was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Check multiple offer IDs. Response media: application/json. Requires an API key with offers:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: POST /v1/offers/slugs was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Resolve multiple offer slugs. Response media: application/json. Requires an API key with offers:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/builds/{targetId}/compare/{baseId} was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Compare two stored build snapshots. Compares immutable file snapshots by full path, ordered by `fileName` in the requested direction with an opaque `fileName` cursor. Responding requires streaming both stored snapshots so the summary, top files, and top directories are complete; the page size is bounded, the scan is not. Full-download deltas are not patch-download estimates. Response media: application/json. Requires an API key with builds:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/assets/{id} was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Get an asset. Looks up a single catalog asset by its Epic Games artifact ID and returns the serialized asset document. Returns `404` when no asset matches. Response media: application/json. Requires an API key with catalog:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/base-game/{namespace} was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Resolve a namespace's base game. Response media: application/json. Requires an API key with catalog:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/builds/{id} was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Get a sanitized build snapshot. Returns one build summary with manifest status, sizes, technologies, and stored size fallbacks from the matching platform asset. Raw manifest locations are never returned. Response media: application/json. Requires an API key with builds:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/builds/{id}/history was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: List comparison candidates for a build. Returns chronological observations for the same label stream or platform as the build, ordered by `firstSeenAt` descending, `createdAt` descending, and `_id` descending. Each entry reports whether it has a comparable stored snapshot and whether it belongs to the same stream; `meta.previousComparableBuildId` identifies the previous comparable snapshot. Response media: application/json. Requires an API key with builds:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/builds/{id}/install-options was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Summarize install tags in a build. Returns a bounded map keyed by install tag, with file counts and total bytes. The map is not paginated; `meta.truncated` reports whether the safety cap was reached. Response media: application/json. Requires an API key with builds:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/builds/{id}/tree was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Expand one directory of a build file tree. Returns only the immediate child files and directories of the requested manifest directory, ordered by node type and then name. Expand a directory by passing the `path` returned for that node. Pass `meta.pagination.nextCursor` as `cursor` to fetch the next page. Response media: application/json. Requires an API key with builds:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/changelist/{id} was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Get a catalog change. Response media: application/json. Requires an API key with catalog:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/collections/{slug} was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Get a collection. Cursor-paginated collection positions ordered by `position` ascending with the offer ID as a unique tie-breaker. Positions with a non-positive position are excluded. `country` selects the pricing region and `locale` localizes offer text; cookies are never used. Cursors are bound to the collection, ordering, country, locale, and page size. Response media: application/json. Requires an API key with offers:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/collections/{slug}/{week} was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Get a collection for one ISO week. Cursor-paginated positions for one ISO week. Each offer is represented by its most recent in-week position; only entries with a positive position are included. The `week` path parameter must match `YYYYWNN` and name a real ISO week, otherwise the endpoint returns a 400 problem instead of the legacy 500. Cursors are bound to the collection, week, ordering, country, locale, and page size. Response media: application/json. Requires an API key with offers:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/collections/{slug}/{week}/og was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Weekly collection share image. Compatibility redirect to the canonical native weekly collection image. Requires an API key with offers:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/featured was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Featured storefront games. Response media: application/json. Requires an API key with catalog:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/franchises/{slug} was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Get a franchise. Returns a franchise and a cursor-paginated page of its offers, ordered by `releaseDate` descending with the offer `id` ascending as tie-breaker. Offers are localized with `locale` and priced for the Epic pricing region that contains `country`. The `stats` object aggregates achievements and time-to-beat data over every offer in the franchise, not only the returned page. Cookies are never used. Response media: application/json. Requires an API key with offers:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/free-games/og was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Free games share image. Compatibility redirect to the canonical native free-games image. Existing image URLs remain available for embeds and crawlers. Requires an API key with catalog:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/free-games/stats was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Free game statistics. Returns giveaway totals, distinct seller counts, repeated giveaways, and the summed value of all recorded giveaways for the selected pricing region. When no price rows exist the value object is still returned with zero amounts and nullable currency codes instead of failing. Response media: application/json. Requires an API key with catalog:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/game-awards was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: The Game Awards modules. Returns the storefront modules for The Game Awards event, each with its localized and expanded offers and current regional price. Modules are ordered by `moduleIndex`; modules without referenced offers are omitted. OG image generation remains outside v1. Response media: application/json. Requires an API key with catalog:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/game-awards/og was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: The Game Awards share image. Compatibility redirect to the canonical native Game Awards image. Requires an API key with stats:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/health was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Service health. Reports Redis and MongoDB connectivity. This endpoint is public and does not require an API key. Response media: application/json. Public metadata operation; no API key required.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/stats/homepage was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Homepage counters. Returns the counters shown on the egdata homepage: tracked offers, price changes observed in the last 72 hours, active discounts, and current giveaways. Counts are resolved for the Epic pricing region that contains `country`. Cookies are never used; `country` defaults to US. Response media: application/json. Requires an API key with stats:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/items/{id} was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Get an item. Returns one catalog item. The catalog `id` is preferred; legacy `_id` values also resolve. Response media: application/json. Requires an API key with items:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/items/{id}/assets was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: List item assets. Returns the asset records whose `itemId` matches the item identifier. Response media: application/json. Requires an API key with items:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/items/{id}/builds was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: List item builds. Returns build summaries for every app referenced by the item's release info, including manifest status, platform, and size metadata. Response media: application/json. Requires an API key with items:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/items/{id}/changelog was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: List item changelog entries. Returns changelog entries for the item, its assets, and its builds as `{ metadata, timestamp, document }` rows ordered by `timestamp` descending with `_id` descending as a stable tie-breaker. Pass `meta.pagination.nextCursor` as `cursor` to fetch the next page. Response media: application/json. Requires an API key with items:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/items/{id}/offer was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Get the current base-game offer for an item. Selects the current base-game offer for the item, preferring offers that are not pre-purchases, and returns it with the current regional price. Offers are filtered by country eligibility before selection. Response media: application/json. Requires an API key with items:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: POST /v1/items/bulk was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Get multiple items. Resolves up to 100 item identifiers in one request. Found items are returned in input order, and identifiers that do not resolve are listed in `meta.missing`. Response media: application/json. Requires an API key with items:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/items-sitemap.xml was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Item sitemap. Native XML sitemap for website item pages. Response media: application/xml. Requires an API key with catalog:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/items/sitemap.xml was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Item sitemap (legacy alias). Response media: application/xml. Requires an API key with catalog:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/latest-games was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Latest catalog additions. Returns the 25 most recently created base games, DLC, and add-ons with current regional prices. Response media: application/json. Requires an API key with catalog:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/stats/creations/monthly was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Monthly base-game creations. Returns the number of base-game offers created per month since December 2018. Pre-purchases and code-redemption-only offers are excluded. Results are cached for one day. Response media: application/json. Requires an API key with stats:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/stats/releases/monthly was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Monthly base-game releases. Returns the number of base-game releases per month since the Epic Games Store launch in December 2018. Pre-purchases and code-redemption-only offers are excluded. Results are cached for one day. Response media: application/json. Requires an API key with stats:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/offers/{id} was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Get an offer. Response media: application/json. Requires an API key with offers:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/offers/{id}/achievements was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Offer achievements. Returns the achievement sets tracked for the offer's sandbox. Base games and add-ons use different achievement sets. Response media: application/json. Requires an API key with offers:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/offers/{id}/age-rating was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Offer age rating. Returns every age rating stored for the offer's sandbox, or only the rating system that applies to the requested country when `single=true`. Missing rating data returns 404. Response media: application/json. Requires an API key with offers:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/offers/{id}/assets was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Offer assets. Returns the assets belonging to the items of this offer, including sub-items and items linked by offer ID. Response media: application/json. Requires an API key with offers:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/offers/{id}/builds was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Offer builds. Returns up to 50 recently updated builds for the offer's assets, including manifest and size summaries. Response media: application/json. Requires an API key with offers:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/offers/{id}/bundle was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Bundle contents. Returns the offers inside a bundle with their regional prices, the bundle price, and the summed contents price. Non-bundle offers return 404. Response media: application/json. Requires an API key with offers:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/offer-by-slug/{slug} was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Resolve an offer slug. Response media: application/json. Requires an API key with catalog:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/offers/{id}/changelog/stats was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Offer change log statistics. Aggregates the offer's change log between two ISO 8601 timestamps into daily counts, weekday counts, change-type counts, and changed-field counts. Invalid or missing timestamps return 400. Response media: application/json. Requires an API key with offers:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/offers/{id}/collection was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Offers in the offer's collection. Returns the offers referenced by this offer's collection attributes with current regional prices. Offers that are not part of a collection return 404. Response media: application/json. Requires an API key with offers:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/offers/{id}/collections/{collection} was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Offer position in a collection. Returns the offer's chart entry in one collection, including the collection name. Response media: application/json. Requires an API key with offers:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/offers/events/{id} was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Get offers in an event. Response media: application/json. Requires an API key with offers:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/offers/{id}/features was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Offer gameplay features. Derives launcher, gameplay features, and Epic feature flags from the offer's tags and the custom attributes of its items. Response media: application/json. Requires an API key with offers:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/offers/{id}/franchises was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Franchises containing an offer. Returns the franchises whose offer list includes this offer. Franchises whose offers all belong to the same namespace are omitted. Response media: application/json. Requires an API key with offers:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/offers/{id}/genres was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Offer genres. Returns the active storefront genre tags attached to the offer. Response media: application/json. Requires an API key with offers:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/offers/{id}/giveaways was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Offer giveaways. Returns every giveaway promotion recorded for this offer, most recent first. Response media: application/json. Requires an API key with offers:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/offers/{id}/has-prepurchase was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Offer has a prepurchase edition. Reports whether another base game in the same namespace is available for prepurchase. Always returns an object with `hasPrepurchase`, plus the prepurchase `offer` when one exists. Response media: application/json. Requires an API key with offers:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/offers/{id}/has-regular was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Offer has a regular edition. For a prepurchase base game, reports whether a regular (non-prepurchase) base game exists in the same namespace. Always returns an object with `isPrepurchase`, plus the regular `offer` when one exists. Response media: application/json. Requires an API key with offers:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/offers/{id}/hltb was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Offer HowLongToBeat data. Returns HowLongToBeat estimates for the offer. Offers without a matched HowLongToBeat entry return 404. Response media: application/json. Requires an API key with offers:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/offers/{id}/igdb was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Offer IGDB data. Response media: application/json. Requires an API key with offers:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/offers/{id}/items was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Offer items. Returns the items referenced by the offer, its sub-items, and any item that links back to the offer. Response media: application/json. Requires an API key with offers:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/offers/{id}/mappings was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Offer store mappings. Response media: application/json. Requires an API key with offers:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/offers/{id}/media was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Offer media. Response media: application/json. Requires an API key with offers:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/offers/{id}/og was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Offer share image (PNG). Native 1200×630 PNG share image. The response is not JSON-wrapped. Response media: image/png, image/webp. Requires an API key with offers:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
endpoints.clientAction: None

endpoints.before: GET /v1/offers/{id}/og.webp was not available in the versioned API.
endpoints.after: Offer share image (WebP). Response media: image/png, image/webp. Requires an API key with offers:read permission; the gateway enforces per-key quotas.
